baseline_models.focus_anchor: The emphatic identification of focus word 2 with focus word 4 joins the fire noun directly to the ma'wa construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Intensely burning fire is not merely located at the destination; the sentence identifies that fire itself as the receiving point into which one finally joins.

activation_trace.role: Fiercely intensified heat supplies the substance of the destination, making punishment and place coincide.
Joining a receiving place supplies the terminal convergence that turns the fire into an active receiver rather than a neutral address.

changed_reading.before: Hell is the person's eventual lodging.
changed_reading.after: The blaze itself is the terminal receiver that gathers the person into belonging with it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same ma'wa-root inventory at focus word 4 carries both reception and a branch of tender concern, while focus word 2 supplies extreme heat.
baseline_models.mechanism: The predicate ordinarily sounds sheltering, yet its subject is consuming heat. Their collision produces an anti-shelter: a place that receives but cannot protect, and whose hospitality is punitive.

activation_trace.role: Severe kindled heat makes the sheltering expectation materially impossible.
The pity and merciful-concern branch leaves a sheltering undertone that the fiery subject sharply reverses.

changed_reading.before: Ma'wa is a value-neutral noun meaning abode.
changed_reading.after: Ma'wa becomes bitterly ironic: the only reception named here is an anti-refuge made of heat.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first removes beings from an established locus and later voices their return to a prior condition; after sudden reappearance, the focus ma'wa becomes the compulsory new affiliation that terminates this loss and recovery of place.

activation_trace.role: Uprooting something from where it was settled supplies the initial de-housing movement.
Return to a thing or its place supplies the contested reversal from displacement to renewed placement.
Joining a receiving side closes the spatial sequence as a final re-housing.

structural_cues: The opening begins with removal from a settled locus; 79:10 questions return, and branchless 79:14 presents a sudden arrival on the exposed surface before 79:39 names the abode.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies uprooting, return, sudden placement, and the focus reception branch; I infer a de-housing and re-housing arc ending in 79:39. Alternatively, these may be separate resurrection stages with no special spatial force in ma'wa.

changed_reading.before: The fire is simply the final place after resurrection.
changed_reading.after: After every prior emplacement is torn up and reversed, the fire is the compulsory place of renewed belonging.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pharaoh exceeds limits, drives a crowd toward his own announced supremacy, and is then seized. Against that sequence, the focus reception image reverses agency: the ruler who gathered others is finally gathered by the fire.

activation_trace.role: Crossing the limit in disobedience supplies the overreach that initiates the reversal.
Driving and collecting a group toward a goal supplies Pharaoh's temporary power to gather.
Grandeur and domineering elevation supply the self-positioning from which he claims control.
Seizure and capture reverse Pharaoh from directing subject into apprehended object.
The receiving and gathering branch makes the fire the final collector in the role reversal.

structural_cues: The Pharaoh narrative runs from command and public assembly to seizure, while 79:37 repeats the same transgression root immediately before the focus conclusion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies Pharaoh's overreach, crowd-gathering, supremacy claim, seizure, and the focus gathering-place; I supply the reversal from gatherer to gathered. Alternatively, Pharaoh may only exemplify punishment without specifying how ma'wa functions.

changed_reading.before: The generic transgressor is assigned a punitive residence.
changed_reading.after: The residence enacts a sovereignty reversal: the self-exalting gatherer becomes what the blaze gathers and holds.

context_deltas.mechanism: The created world is assembled, completed, stabilized, and furnished for benefit. This habitat-making sequence activates ma'wa as more than an address: the focus presents a counter-habitat whose receiving medium is blaze rather than ordered provision.

activation_trace.role: Construction by joining parts supplies the made environment against which the final abode is read.
Integrity and completion supply the world's fitted, coherent character.
Fixity and rooted stability make the prior environment habitable rather than transient.
Enjoyable benefit names the use served by the created habitat and sharpens its reversal in the focus.
Severe heat replaces provision as the material character of the counter-habitat.
Reception into a gathering place lets the creation tableau reframe the punishment as an inhabiting environment.

structural_cues: 79:27-33 forms a continuous construction-and-provision tableau immediately before the overwhelming event and the paired destination clauses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a built, completed, stabilized, beneficial environment and then a fiery ma'wa; I analogize the two as habitat and counter-habitat. The live alternative is that the creation tableau proves resurrection power only and does not characterize either abode.

changed_reading.before: Hell is a location containing punishment.
changed_reading.after: Hell is an anti-habitat: an environment of reception that reverses the world's fitted stability and benefit by making blaze itself its medium.

context_deltas.mechanism: Preference fixes attention on the near and lower life; the following contrast either restrains the self or lets desire incline and fall. The focus ma'wa therefore reads as the settled terminus of a direction already taken, not an unrelated address assigned afterward.

activation_trace.role: Preferential choice supplies the act that orients the person's trajectory.
Nearness supplies the short-range object toward which preference is directed.
Restraint and checking an act supply the counterforce that can interrupt the trajectory.
The self's inclination supplies the inward directional force opposed by restraint.
Falling into a depth spatializes unchecked inclination as descent toward a terminus.
Joining a receiving destination converts repeated preference into settled belonging.

structural_cues: 79:37-39 and 79:40-41 are matched conditional units, and 79:41 repeats the same emphatic ma'wa predicate with the opposite subject.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies preference for the near life, restraint versus desire, and opposing repeated ma'wa frames; I infer that the moral directions mature into corresponding destinations. Alternatively, the pair may classify outcomes without depicting choice as spatial motion.

changed_reading.before: Fire is assigned after a bad preference has been judged.
changed_reading.after: The fire is where the preference's own nearward and downward orientation finally settles and belongs.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hell is brought out into exposure, whereas the opposed garden activates covering and concealment. Because both receive the same ma'wa predicate, the focus abode becomes an exposed anti-refuge rather than merely the hotter member of a destination pair.

activation_trace.role: Emergence and uncovering strip the fiery destination of concealment.
Covering and hiddenness supply the opposite destination's protective spatial regime.
The fierce heat is the exposed substance from which the destination offers no cover.
The branch of compassionate concern sharpens the absence of protection in this uncovered abode.

structural_cues: 79:36 first exposes the fire; 79:39 and 79:41 then use matched emphatic destination clauses for fire and garden.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exposed fire, a concealment-bearing garden root, and matched ma'wa syntax; I infer opposed regimes of exposure and cover. Alternatively, the garden root's concealment image may be lexical background without an operative visual contrast here.

changed_reading.before: Fire and garden are simply two places distinguished by reward and punishment.
changed_reading.after: The focus names the unsheltering destination: a receiving place made public and bare, opposed to an abode whose very name carries cover.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing perception compresses an earlier stay into no more than a bright morning or an evening. Against that brief remembered occupancy, ma'wa gains temporal weight as the residence that follows when the former stay has collapsed in scale.

activation_trace.role: The morning's limited extension supplies one boundary of the compressed remembered interval.
Remaining in a place supplies the temporary occupancy placed in contrast with ma'wa.
Evening time supplies the other part-day measure of the diminished stay.
Joining a receiving place gives the focus destination a settled quality against the compressed stay.

structural_cues: The hour question in 79:42-46 closes the surah after the paired destination clauses and ends with an evening-or-morning comparison.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies staying, part-day measures, and ma'wa's settled reception; I use the closing interval as a temporal foil for the focus abode. The exact referent of the compressed stay is uncertain, and the focus does not itself specify duration.

changed_reading.before: Ma'wa marks sequence only: it is the place reached later.
changed_reading.after: Ma'wa is temporally weighted as the settled residence disclosed once the preceding stay is perceived as only part of a day.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it personifies the fire through a form-distant eye branch. It remains anchored in focus word 2 and is activated by the surah's repeated eyes, sight, and uncovering; downstream prose should call it visual personification, not literal sentience.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 2 has a branch of the staring or kindled eye, and the emphatic clause makes that visually charged fire the ma'wa.

activation_trace.role: The glaring or kindled eye image gives the fire a visually confrontational face.
Physical eyesight foregrounds the beholder's vulnerable side of the encounter.
Seeing by eye or insight makes the destination an encountered object rather than an unseen abstraction.
Uncovering brings the visually charged fire out to meet the viewer.

changed_reading.before: The person sees and then enters a passive fiery location.
changed_reading.after: The destination is visually confrontational, almost a glaring abode that meets the beholder's gaze as it receives them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the compassion branch is not the ordinary direct sense of ma'wa. It remains anchored in focus word 4 and is activated by the offered purification and gentle guidance followed by denial and disobedience; downstream prose should present it only as a latent counter-reading of refused harbor.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 4 belongs to a root inventory with a branch of pity and merciful concern, now predicated of severe fire.

activation_trace.role: Merciful concern supplies the distant harboring possibility whose reversal remains audible in the focus.
Purity and soundness supply the offered alternative state.
Gentle indication toward a path supplies an offered route toward another end.
Charging the sign or messenger with falsehood marks rejection of the offered route.
Departure from obedience turns rejection into enacted refusal.
Severe heat makes the resulting 'harbor' an inversion rather than an instance of compassion.

changed_reading.before: The focus only names the endpoint imposed on rejection.
changed_reading.after: The fiery ma'wa carries a faint, bitter echo of compassionate harbor foreclosed by the refusal of purification and gentle guidance.

strongest_changes: Ma'wa became a terminal receiver after an arc of uprooting and return, not merely a static place name.
The Pharaoh sequence turned the focus into a reversal in which the public gatherer is himself gathered and held by the blaze.
Preference, nearness, restraint, and desire made the paired abodes read as settled termini of opposed trajectories.
The creation tableau and the exposed-versus-covered contrast reframed the fire as an infernal counter-habitat and anti-refuge.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package repeatedly changed the force of one compact identification: motion supplied terminal convergence, Pharaoh supplied social reversal, creation supplied habitat structure, and the paired clause supplied directional and sheltering contrast without forcing those readings into one synthesis.
remaining_uncertainties: The pity branch of ء و ي may be only a distant cognate echo rather than active in the nominal ma'wa.
The glaring-eye branch of ج ح م supports visual personification but not a claim that the fire is literally animate.
The creation passage may function only as proof of power rather than as a habitat analogy.
The referent of the compressed stay in 79:46 remains uncertain, and 79:39 itself does not state duration.
